_To_export_1_Password_logins__first_logi.en:
To export 1Password logins, first login to 1Password.

On Windows, select one or more logins, right click on one item, click Export, and then enter your 1Password Master Password. A Save As dialog is displayed. Select a location for the file containing your exported logins. For 'Save as type', select 'Comma-separated values (*.csv)'.

On macOS, open the File menu and click Export > Selected items or All items. Enter your 1Password Master Password. A Save As dialog is displayed. Select a location for the file containing your exported logins. Save as either 1Password Interchange Format (.1pif) or Comma Delimited Text (.csv).

After exporting your 1Password vault, click the Import button below and locate the file containing your 1Password logins.
_To_export_1_Password_logins__first_logi.zh:
若要匯出 1Password 登入資料，請先登入 1Password。

在 Windows 上，選取一個或多個登入資料，在其中一個項目上按右鍵，按一下 Export，然後輸入您的 1Password 主密碼。畫面會顯示「另存新檔」對話方塊，請選取存放匯出登入資料檔案的位置，「存檔類型」請選取「Comma-separated values (*.csv)」。

在 macOS 上，開啟 File 選單並按一下「Export > Selected items」或「All items」，輸入您的 1Password 主密碼。畫面會顯示「另存新檔」對話方塊，請選取存放匯出登入資料檔案的位置，儲存為 1Password Interchange Format (.1pif) 或 Comma Delimited Text (.csv)。

匯出 1Password 保管庫後，按一下下方的「匯入」按鈕，找到含有 1Password 登入資料的檔案。
